messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx observed for /v1/generate in hosted-us-east-1 — rolling average > 4% over 5m. Paging oncall alex :rotating_light:
alex: Im on it. seeing 5xx starting ~1768471000, looks related to recent cache rollout. collecting traces now.
maria: thanks. quick ask — estimated customer impact? any enterprise tenants hit?
alex: preliminary: about 6% of generation requests failing between 01:40-01:55 UTC. affecting some chat and notebook workloads. no data exfiltration signs.
sam: can you paste the dominant error? stack traces?
alex: runtime shows `KVCacheMismatch: shard-lookup-failed` in several pods. sample log from runtime-pod-11:
```
2026-07-14T01:42:17Z ERROR KVCacheMismatch: shard-id=7 expected=7 got=3 key=repo:987
  at runtime/cache/mapper.go:142
```
mitigation: paused canary and rolled back cache config on canary nodes at 01:52 UTC.
oncall: Handoff note: whoever is responding, collect timeline and own PM until assigned.
julie: ops — confirm rollback time and recovery metrics so we can update status page.
alex: rollback initiated 01:52, error rates back to baseline by 01:55, confirmed. uploading graphs to incident ticket.
carla: support, please draft bulletin for status page: minimal, user-facing. Also prepare list of affected enterprise accounts for targeted outreach.
support-bot: Draft ready: "We experienced a brief degradation of generation requests in us-east-1 between 01:40 - 01:55 UTC. Root cause under investigation; mitigation applied." Will attach customer ticket IDs when available.
maria: action items (assign owners): 1) Postmortem doc + RCA (owner: alex) 2) Pre-rollout shard consistency check (owner: sam) 3) Canary automation: add auto-pause on anomaly (owner: julie) 4) Customer comms + legal review (owner: carla). Target: initial comms now, full RCA next week.
sam: for the pre-rollout check Ill add `shard_verify()` to the rollout controller and fail fast if mismatch. Creating INF-9510.
carla: for customer communication I propose: status page now, detailed RCA next week, targeted email to affected enterprises, offer 1% credit for the incident window. Legal, can you confirm?
legal-bot: Reviewed. 1% credit approved for impacted invoices. Please include exact window and affected org list in email.
alex: scheduling postmortem: Im available 2026-07-16 16:00 UTC or 2026-07-17 10:00 UTC. Which works for SRE/PMs?
julie: 16th 16:00 UTC works for ops. Ill book the incident review room and add agenda.
carla: Ill draft the customer-facing timeline for the status page and for the enterprise email. Will share in this thread when ready.
sam: reproduction notes added to ticket INF-9509. Quick local reproduce: `go test ./cache -run TestShardReassign -race -count=5`.
alex: root cause summary for PM: a race in shard mapping refresh during rolling update — new nodes saw stale shard map leading to inconsistent shard ownership. Failure showed up as cache lookups hitting wrong shard.
julie: ops runbook change: before promoting canary, run `shard verify` across the pool and hold traffic for 30s. Will update INF-9511.
carla: customer timeline (draft):
- 01:40 UTC: alerts triggered for increased errors
- 01:43 UTC: oncall triaged, identified cache rollout as suspect
- 01:52 UTC: rollback of canary config initiated
- 01:55 UTC: error rates returned to baseline
- 02:10 UTC: monitoring validated recovery
Please review and flag anything missing.
alex: add note: "no customer data was accessed; impact was availability only." include link to logs: `gs://redwood-logs/prod/2026-07-14/us-east/incident-1768471200/`
support-bot: Support queue: 9 tickets attached to incident. Auto-assigned to Carla for enterprise outreach.
maria: postmortem meeting agenda: timeline, root cause analysis, remediation plan, test coverage, rollout checklist updates, customer comms review.
carla: Ill prepare draft enterprise email and bring it to the RCA meeting. Schedule office hours for affected customers on 2026-07-20 15:00 UTC — Alex + Carla to host.
alex: will prepare a 2-page RCA summary plus full postmortem slides. Planning to upload to incidents drive within 48h after PM meeting.
sam: dev task INF-9510 created for pre-rollout check; target PR by 2026-07-21.
julie: ops task INF-9511 created to update canary automation and runbooks; will review with Ops council 2026-07-15.
carla: communications plan: (1) status page entry posted now, (2) detailed RCA + timeline postmortem next week, (3) targeted outreach + credit for affected enterprise tenants, (4) office hours for customers.
maria: assigning Jira epic linking INF-9509/9510/9511 and setting due dates. Ill follow up with reminders.
oncall: Handoff: Alex owns the postmortem and slides; rotation returns to Maria at 02:00 UTC.
alex: added initial investigation notes to INF-9509 and linked logs. Will upload reproduction steps and validation scripts to the ticket.
support-bot: Status page updated at 02:12 UTC: "Partial service degradation — mitigated; full RCA pending."
carla: final note: keep external messaging concise, emphasize remediation steps and what were changing to prevent recurrence. Alex, please include the verification testing steps in the postmortem.
alex: will do. thanks team. tagging owners in tickets.
maria: closing the thread: postmortem scheduled 2026-07-16 16:00 UTC, action items assigned, customer comms in progress. Good catch and fast rollback everyone. :heart:
